decisions.reason: The margin analysis extends the firm's core market-data offer and has its own page, so it likely meets aspirations at low marginal cost, and slack lets the firm carry it while results mature.

The gas tariff comparison sits very close to the established tariff-database business and uses the same maintained data, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.
The electricity tariff calculator is a core-adjacent product with its own page that fits the platform strategy, so management sees no reason to withdraw it.
This multi-model line is only mentioned on the website and partly overlaps with C and F, so consolidation is possible, but it is cheap to maintain and fits the platform, so it is kept.
The area definition tool supports the location-based offerings and integrates into the central platform, so it is retained as a complementary module.
The site-specific comparison line is only mentioned on the website and may be merged with other tariff tools, but it uses existing data and resources, so keeping it is the satisficing choice.
